pageProps.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: There are Happy Things Every Day
pageProps.review: A book review where you can find heart-warming comfort and simple messages from Winnie-the-Pooh to discover small hidden happinesses every day and gain peace of mind during difficult times.
pageProps.description: Don't worry even if you feel like you're going to be depressed. You might just be hungry.
pageProps.content:
## Review A book where you can receive comfort through words that are simpler than expected and helpful in reality when you're having a hard time. A book for F, not T.
If you read it in a difficult situation, there will be one or two words among the simple words Winnie-the-Pooh delivers that can comfort you. A good book to flick through again every now and then.
You're not happy every day, but there are happy things every day.
